Sahil Banerjee
Azure DevOps Engineer | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
sahil.banerjee240@example.com | +91 9929533914

Early-career Azure DevOps Engineer focused on building repeatable CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code, and containerized application delivery. Comfortable working in Agile teams to streamline deployments and reduce lead time for changes. Seeking to expand hands-on experience across cloud-native and automation tools.

Experience
Cognizant — Feb 2026 - Present
Azure DevOps Engineer, Hybrid
- Implemented automated CI/CD pipelines for a microservices application on Microsoft Azure using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning, reducing environment setup time by 70% and decreasing deployment errors by 45%.
- Containerized services with Docker and designed a build/push workflow that cut image build failures by 60% and standardized release artifacts across environments.
- Automated configuration management and application deployments with Ansible, creating playbooks that reduced manual steps by 80% and enabled consistent rollbacks in under 15 minutes.
- Collaborated in Agile sprints and used Git and Confluence for source control and documentation; integrated Kubernetes (K8s) staging clusters to validate releases and improved deployment frequency to twice daily.

Projects
- CI/CD Pipeline Template: Developed a reusable pipeline template repository on Azure DevOps incorporating Terraform plans, Docker image builds, and Ansible deployment stages. Reuse across two internal teams saved approximately 120 engineer-hours per quarter.
- Local K8s Playbook: Built a local development workflow using K8s and Docker Compose to mirror cloud deployments; documented setup and runbooks in Confluence for onboarding new team members.

Skills
Cloud: Microsoft Azure
Infra as Code & Orchestration: Terraform, K8s
Containers & Automation: Docker, Ansible
Collaboration & Process: Git, Confluence, Agile

Education
B.Tech, Computer Engineering, MPSTME NMIMS

Notice period: 30 days
